what: SLOOP's four-track groovebox on the SMK-37, in two builds. Mewcoder turns track 3 into a 20-channel vocoder after the Sennheiser VSM201, with two routed USB audio inputs for your voice, a carrier or an instrument. Multichannel sends six USB audio stems to your DAW, with a punch-in on every one.
author: MiloMeowzers
